name: tabs
description: 选项卡：基于 Ark UI Tabs 原语，键盘导航与受控/非受控双模式。

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Tabs as ArkTabs } from "@ark-ui/vue/tabs";

interface Props {
  /** 当前激活的 tab 值（配合 v-model:value）；不传时为非受控 */
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  /** 切换模式：automatic 悬停聚焦即切换 / manual 需点击或 Enter */
  activationMode?: "automatic" | "manual";
  lazyMount?: boolean;
  unmountOnExit?: boolean;
}

const props = defineProps<Props>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ "update:value": [value: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkTabs.Root
    :model-value="props.value"
    :default-value="props.defaultValue"
    :activation-mode="props.activationMode"
    :lazy-mount="props.lazyMount"
    :unmount-on-exit="props.unmountOnExit"
    @update:model-value="(value: string) => emit('update:value', value)"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkTabs.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Tabs as ArkTabs } from "@ark-ui/vue/tabs";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface Props {
  value: string;
  class?: string;
}

const props = defineProps<Props>();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkTabs.Content :value="props.value" :class="cn('flex-1 outline-none', props.class)">
    <slot />
  </ArkTabs.Content>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Tabs as ArkTabs } from "@ark-ui/vue/tabs";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface Props {
  class?: string;
}

const props = defineProps<Props>();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkTabs.List
    :class="
      cn(
        'bg-muted text-muted-foreground inline-flex h-9 w-fit items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-[3px]',
        props.class,
      )
    "
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkTabs.List>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Tabs as ArkTabs } from "@ark-ui/vue/tabs";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface Props {
  value: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  class?: string;
}

const props = defineProps<Props>();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkTabs.Trigger
    :value="props.value"
    :disabled="props.disabled"
    :class="
      cn(
        'data-[selected]:bg-background data-[selected]:text-foreground inline-flex h-[calc(100%-1px)] flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-transparent px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-[color,box-shadow] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-[3px] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 data-[selected]:shadow-sm',
        props.class,
      )
    "
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkTabs.Trigger>
</template>
